description: This file contains a PHP class 'Credit' within the OpenCart system that extends the base model class. The class handles functionalities related to the 'Credit' total in the e-commerce application, including calculating the total credit deduction, confirming transactions, and unconfirming (reversing) credit transactions. It appears to be part of the OpenCart extension system for order total modifications.

classes.name: Credit
classes.description: Represents the credit total extension, managing customer credit balance calculations, transactions, and order total adjustments.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Retrieves the total customer credit and adjusts the order total accordingly. Loads language strings, fetches customer balance, and, if positive, adds a credit entry to the totals array.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms the transaction by adding a customer transaction record when an order is confirmed. Adds a transaction record with the order ID and value.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Reverses the credit transaction by deleting the transaction record associated with the order ID, typically when an order is canceled or reverted.
